name: simple-cell
description: A fast, modern spreadsheet that opens and saves Excel and OpenDocument workbooks

scripts.e2e:headless: npm run build && xvfb-run -a playwright test
scripts.icons: magick -background none resources/icon.svg -depth 8 resources/icon.png && magick -size 1024x1024 xc:none \( resources/icon.png -resize 942x942 -background none -gravity center -extent 1024x1024 \( +clone -background black -shadow 30x12+0+10 \) +swap -background none -layers merge \) -layers flatten -depth 8 resources/icon-mac.png && for s in 16 24 32 48 64 128 256 512; do magick resources/icon.png -filter Lanczos -resize ${s}x${s} -depth 8 resources/icons/${s}x${s}.png; done
